name: creatures-animal-marketplace
description: Find public animal listings, breeders and livestock services on Creatures. Read-only, no Creatures account needed.

interface.longDescription:
Creatures (creatures.com) is a marketplace and directory for livestock, pets and exotic animals across the United
States and Canada. With this app, ChatGPT can search public Creatures data and answer with links to the pages it used.

Use it to:
- find animals for sale by species, breed, sex, sale type, price, state or a city you name
- find breeders by species, breed and state
- find livestock haulers and boarding, hoof care, shearing, reproduction and processing services
- read a listing, animal profile, breeder, species or breed page, or a creatures.com link you paste
- answer questions about how Creatures works, such as fees and supported countries

Example requests: "Find Highland cattle for sale in Virginia on Creatures." "Find Nigerian Dwarf goat breeders in
Texas." "Who can haul cattle in Tennessee?"

The app is read-only and needs no Creatures account. Structured responses exclude account email addresses, phone numbers, street addresses, postal codes and map coordinates. Public titles, descriptions and other text are returned as written and may include contact details the author chose to publish. Purchases, messages and bids happen on creatures.com.
